mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS ID, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE_ENC AS PHONE_ENC, REGION_SIDO AS REGION_SIDO, REGION_SIGUNGU AS REGION_SIGUNGU, STATUS, BANNED_YN AS BANNED_YN, KEY_VER AS KEY_VER FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT PASSWORD_HASH FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND BANNED_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
SELECT MEMBER_ID AS ID, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE_ENC AS PHONE_ENC, REGION_SIDO AS REGION_SIDO, REGION_SIGUNGU AS REGION_SIGUNGU, STATUS, BANNED_YN, KEY_VER FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, PHONE_ENC, REGION_SIDO, REGION_SIGUNGU, STATUS, BANNED_YN, KEY_VER) VALUES (SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phoneEnc}, #{regionSido}, #{regionSigungu}, 'ACTIVE', 'N', #{keyVer})
mapper.select: SELECT PASSWORD_HASH FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND BANNED_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) AND MEMBER_ID != #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET NAME = #{name}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE_ENC = #{phoneEnc}, KEY_VER = #{keyVer}, REGION_SIDO = #{regionSido}, REGION_SIGUNGU = #{regionSigungu}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND BANNED_YN = 'N'
UPDATE MEMBER SET PASSWORD_HASH = #{passwordHash}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND BANNED_YN = 'N'
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN', WITHDRAWN_AT = SYSDATE, PURGE_DUE_AT = SYSDATE + 30, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER GM JOIN GYE_GROUP GG ON GG.GROUP_ID = GM.GROUP_ID WHERE GM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND GG.STATUS IN ('RECRUITING', 'ACTIVE', 'DISSOLVE_PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE OWNER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS IN ('RECRUITING', 'ACTIVE', 'DISSOLVE_PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE JOIN_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE MEMBER_CONSENT SET AGREED_YN = 'N', REVOKED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND AGREED_YN = 'Y' AND TERMS_ID IN (SELECT TERMS_ID FROM TERMS_POLICY WHERE REQUIRED_YN = 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' AND PURGE_DUE_AT IS NOT NULL AND PURGE_DUE_AT <= SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET NAME = '탈퇴회원', EMAIL = NULL, PASSWORD_HASH = NULL, PHONE_ENC = NULL, SYN_ID = NULL, STATUS = 'DELETED', PURGED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' AND PURGE_DUE_AT <= SYSDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, SIGNUP_TYPE, PHONE_ENC, REGION_SIDO, REGION_SIGUNGU, STATUS, BANNED_YN, KEY_VER ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{email}, NULL, #{signupType}, #{phoneEnc}, #{regionSido}, #{regionSigungu}, 'ACTIVE', 'N', #{keyVer} )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
